reason: I like that it is cheap and that I would not have to type everything in, but I already keep my spending in a spreadsheet and I know I would forget to scan the slips most days. Then the app is just a half-filled list that I would stop opening.
objection: I'll forget to scan the slips every day, and then the numbers are wrong and I go back to my spreadsheet.
would_change_my_mind: If the free trial showed me a full week where scanning took under a minute and the categories were right without me fixing them, I would keep it.
